property_summary: Once Initialized() has been called, any subsequent SetLogFile call must revert (the log address is frozen); the mutant deletes the guard so the call succeeds, breaking this universal rule.
change_summary: Delete the `if(intitalized)revert();` guard so Log can be changed even after initialization, letting a post-Initialized SetLogFile call change the log address (P would revert and keep it unchanged).
